title: Track Guide Oran Park   Grand Prix MX5 Fixed iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.spoken_as: turn in when the green wall ends
corners.braking: turn in when the green wall ends

corners.label: T2
corners.braking: hit the curb on the inside, brake hard to turn-in
corners.line: stick close to the curb on the inside, go wide on exit
corners.exit: throttle on exit, stay close to the curb
corners.mistakes: go too far and drop a wheel, end up in the wall

corners.spoken_as: my breaking marker is this tire wall here on the left
corners.braking: brake hard to 95%, trail brake to curb
corners.exit: throttle on exit, stay within curb

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: here on the left, short hit to 80% brake pressure, quickly off brake
corners.line: get close to the curb, but not too much
corners.exit: apply throttle again, Full Throttle instantly
lift off throttle completely or to 30% at tire barrier

corners.braking: a car length before the curb, quick hit to 50% brake pressure, quickly off brake
corners.line: go over the red and yellow curb on the inside, all the way onto the white curb
corners.mistakes: going on the white curb too early

corners.label: T10
corners.braking: Brake before getting to the bottom of the hill, hard to 95-100%, trail brake to inside curb.
corners.line: Take shortest route, use some curb.
corners.exit: Apply throttle on darkened part, keep full throttle.
corners.mistakes: Taking too much curb causes spin, use 2nd gear to avoid spin.

corners.label: T11
corners.braking: Brake before getting to the bottom of the hill, hard to 95-100%, trail brake to inside curb.
corners.line: Take shortest route, use all curb.
corners.exit: Apply throttle on darkened part, keep full throttle.
corners.mistakes: Taking too much curb causes spin, use 2nd gear to avoid spin.

corners.label: T12
corners.braking: Brake before getting to the bottom of the hill, hard to 95-100%, trail brake to inside curb.
corners.line: Take shortest route, use all curb.
corners.exit: Apply throttle on darkened part, keep full throttle.
corners.mistakes: Taking too much curb causes spin, use 2nd gear to avoid spin.

general_tips: keep in mind that people will try and overtake you into turn one
use turn one as your breaking marker for turn two
use this tire wall here on the left as your breaking marker for turn three
